learning_outcomes.text: Students should demonstrate the ability to competently process a problem from the field of engineering sciences using scientific methods within a reasonable timeframe.
Students should be able to solve a problem from the field of mechanical engineering independently, systematically, and creatively using engineering methods.
The thesis should preferably address problems from practical business operations.
Students are able to analyze a problem from the dual company using scientific methods and develop a solution approach (for dual students).
Through the presentation, the student demonstrates the ability to systematically work on a technical problem and to present and defend the chosen solution approach comprehensibly (for dual students).

assessment_methods.method: Presentation of thesis results (for dual students)

assessment_rules: The Bachelor thesis is a written scientific paper, 40-60 pages in length. It is supervised by a professor and evaluated by two reviewers, one of whom should be the supervisor. For dual students, the thesis is to be prepared in collaboration with the respective dual company, and the results are presented to the dual partner and the first examiner.
